issues.problem: The formula N = ⌊1/ε⌋ + 1 is shown for all presets without explaining why it works for all three sequences (1/n, (n+1)/n, (−1)ⁿ/n). While the formula is correct for all three (since |a_n − L| = 1/n in all cases), students might be confused about why the same formula applies to different sequences.
issues.fix: Add a brief note that for all three sequences, |a_n − L| = 1/n, so the same formula applies. Or derive the formula for each sequence separately.

factErrors: Beat “sequence”, BEFORE in all four presets: “giá trị đi lên”/“the value goes up” is false; 1/n and (n+1)/n decrease toward their limits, while (−1)^n/n oscillates.
Beat “band”, AFTER for inv-0.05 and n1-0.1: “a few first terms” is numerically misleading; the strict condition first holds at n=21 and n=11, so respectively 20 and 10 initial terms are not inside.

Beat “shrink”, AFTER and its second hint: “the narrower the band, the larger N” is false as a strict implication; the least valid N is only nondecreasing and can stay equal, for example ε=0.20 and ε=0.19 both give N=6.

The find-n hint and the closing definition omit necessary conditions: the derivation uses ε>0, and convergence requires that for every ε>0 there exists a natural number N. The unrestricted claim is false, for example at ε=0 for 1/n.

The closing generalization presents ε→0⇒N→∞ as part of the general meaning of convergence. It is true for these four formulas but is not required in general; an eventually constant sequence has bounded least valid N.

issues.problem: The calculation is written only for 1/n and is never connected explicitly to the other active presets; none of N=6, 21, 11, 5 is stated in the teacher narration.
issues.fix: Use |a_n−L|=1/n for all four active sequences, then calculate 1/n<ε separately for ε=0.20, 0.05, 0.10, and 0.25 to obtain N=6, 21, 11, and 5.

issues.problem: The strict boundary and the reason for the extra 1 are not explained.
issues.fix: State that ε>0 and 1/n<ε is equivalent to n>1/ε. If 1/ε is an integer, equality is excluded, so N=1/ε+1; for ε=0.20, a₅=0.20 lies on the excluded boundary and N=6.

issues.where: beat find-n, AFTER, and beat shrink
issues.problem: A finite cluster of plotted dots alone cannot prove that every later index remains inside the band.
issues.fix: Add the algebraic argument that each active sequence has |a_n−L|=1/n, which decreases with n; once it is below ε, all later deviations remain below ε.

issues.problem: No intermediate width-and-index values are named, so the claimed rightward motion of N cannot be checked quantitatively from the words.
issues.fix: Label checkpoints such as ε=0.20, 0.10, 0.05 with N=6, 11, 21 for 1/n.

issues.problem: All three sequence formulas are listed for every frame, so the active preset is not visually isolated.
issues.fix: Display only the active formula and its deviation |a_n−L|; show the other formulas only in a clearly labelled alternatives menu.
